messages:
Aisha (product): Heads-up — AtlasFin (pilot customer) pushed back: they need provable audit evidence for SOC2 + BYOK rotation before we enable Dedicated. Specifically: signed export bundles, per-tenant retention (up to 7y), and a key-rotation/escrow sketch. Can we map this to launch acceptance criteria?
Ben (eng-runtime): We can produce signed export manifests. Thinking: bundle -> compute SHA256 of blobs -> sign with a customer-managed KMS asymmetric key (RSA-PSS) so they can verify. Quick sketch:```yaml
export: 
  format: tar.gz
  manifest_hash: sha256:...
  signature: base64(...)
  signer: projects/atlas-kms/keys/tenant-key/cryptoKeyVersions/1
```
This avoids shipping raw keys and keeps verification straightforward.
Ravi (security): Important: rotation semantics matter. If tenant rotates keys, previous exports must still be verifiable. We should define: 1) per-export key version metadata, 2) a published key history (or allow customers to provide archived public keys). Also threat model: signed export + transport encryption + audit trail of who requested the export.
Marta (ops): Two ops asks: indexing/search SLA for retained audit logs (customers will want fast search for investigations) and storage cost. Full 7y indexing for all tenants is expensive. Can we offer tiers: "indexed for 90d" vs "cold archive (searchable within 48h)"? Also we need a legal-hold toggle — exports shouldn't be purged if legal hold is active.
Aisha (product): Good points. Proposed acceptance criteria for pilot: 1) export bundle with signed manifest (verifiable by tenant), 2) configurable retention lanes (hot 90d indexed, cold 7y archival), 3) BYOK rotation support with preserved verification of old exports, 4) legal-hold flag prevents purge, 5) documented runbook for export requests and SLA.
Ben (eng-runtime): Implementation notes: 1) use KMS AsymmetricSign API per-export, attach `key_version` metadata to manifest, 2) store public-key fingerprints for quick verification, 3) support `export --format signed-tar` in API, 4) timeline: 2 sprints for MVP (signing + manifest + basic retention lanes), +1 sprint for rotation/backward verification.
Ravi (security): Also add automated integrity checks in Console UI so customers can upload a public key and verify an export client-side. Include audit events for: export requested, export delivered, signature verified.
Marta (ops): We'll need cost estimate in PRD: e.g., index cost = ~0.02 USD/GB/month for hot index, archival cost = ~0.001 USD/GB/month. Also runbook bullet: `on export request -> verify identity -> enqueue export -> sign -> store link -> notify customer`.
legal-bot: Heads-up from Legal: add contract clause for "export availability" and "signed evidence" timeframe (we usually do 30 days). Tagging @legal to draft language.
Aisha (product): OK — I'll synthesize into a short PRD and acceptance checklist, then schedule a 30m working session (eng/security/ops/legal) this week. Action items: Ben to prototype manifest schema, Ravi to draft rotation/verification policy, Marta to estimate index vs archive cost, legal to draft clause.
Ben (eng-runtime): On it. I'll drop a minimal manifest schema in the PRD by EOD.
Ravi (security): Will prep the rotation policy and threat model doc.
Marta (ops): I'll run numbers and outline the runbook.
Aisha (product): Thanks all :thumbsup: I’ll create the PRD link and invite you to the sync.
